prompt.alinti: You're probably tired of your AI assistant not knowing your company data. Most chatbots are smart, but they can't see the files or software you use for your actual work every day. Imagine you have a digital filing cabinet full of important records, but your AI is standing outside the room because it doesn't have the key to get inside. This project solves that by acting like a universal translator for your computer systems. It lets you link up apps like your database or customer management software so your AI can finally answer specific questions about your business. It's like giving your assistant a pair of glasses so it can finally read the private documents sitting right on your desk. You keep everything on your own computers, which means your sensitive information stays private instead of being sent out to a big tech company. It's currently sitting at 246 stars from people who want more control over their AI technology. You can set it up to talk to over 200 different systems without needing to write any complicated computer code yourself.

yontem.ne: REST/SOAP/GraphQL/SQL sistemlerine entegrasyon sağlayan, AI'lara şirket verilerine erişim sağlayan bir arayüz.
yontem.alinti: Give Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot safe access to the software your company already runs. without code, on your own infrastructure—and it learns how your systems connect.

yontem.alinti: 256 ready adapters, any REST/SOAP/GraphQL/SQL system without code, on your own infrastructure—and it learns how your systems connect.

akis.ne: Kullanıcı, `mkdir anythingmcp && cd anythingmcp` komutunu çalıştırarak proje dizinini oluşturur.
Kullanıcı, `curl -fsSL docker-compose.yml` komutu ile Docker Compose dosyasını indirir.
Kullanıcı, `docker-compose up -d http://localhost:3000` komutu ile servisi başlatır.
